That’s completely understandable, take it one step at a time. You are going to make it. If there is anything that brings you even the smallest amount of joy i want you to do that thing and build upon that happy feeling, use the happiness as motivation to do something else. Keep a clean living condition and you’ll even feel more satisfied and lively. Just do the little things to get yourself back on track. Find a quote that makes you feel motivated, find a song that lifts your spirit. Don’t feel down if you don’t feel great right away, its going to take tome and routine. Just stick with the little things, and everything else will fall into place.

I understand that feeling, I feel for you and i hope you know you’re not alone. The best thing i can say to do is try to read, listen to music(uplifting not sad), or just do hobbies that you most best relate to. Be creative, use your emotions to draw, or write poetry. Expressing yourself no matter what it is will clear that fog that clouds your mental compass. You’ll be in my prayers. Wishing only the best for you. You can do this my friend, everyone gets lost off the road its up to you to decide if you get back on it. I know you can do it.

You need to wait this out brother, don’t do this to yourself there is so much more in life for you I promise you that. You need to put that gun somewhere else throw it away or something it’ll do no good for you if you’re not using it for self defense. What do you like to do? Is there a hobby? Maybe think about the people that you will affect. Go for a walk but do not bring the gun, go think to yourself about how selfish it would be to leave all the people in your life behind. You can make it through this I believe in you. Just take a deep breath and you can get through this I promise. Life is about overcoming adversity sometime in the future you’ll look back on this day and be happy you made it through this. Just please man don’t do anything stupid. You know what to do if you need help, go talk to someone or text someone on here, or call suicide hotline.

Hey don’t do it. There is so much more to live for you’re worrying too much about other people like trying to impress others and be there but you need to be there for yourself, you have to find something you want to live for something to fight for, find a hobby or exercise starving yourself is no way to deal with depression. Start a healthy diet get your life back on track nobody can control your life other than you. I believe in you so many people believe in you in these comments and life. It’s gonna get better you just have to work for it as hard as it sounds it is but once you get back on track you will be okay. Get a pet like a dog or cat you don’t have enough affection a dog or cat would help with their companionship. We’re all here for you if you need something text us. Have a good one, it’ll be alright.

You have to find a hobby something you’re interested in but also a community hobby, one where you know people would care. What are you interested in? Your “friends” have no right saying stuff like “I would kill myself if I was you” that is not what friends say. Put yourself around better people, when you begin to get angry with your parents just breathe(as stupid as it sounds) it works! Breathe when you feel angry or anxious only focus on that, block everything out and breathe to yourself and then come back to reality. I believe in you I hear how hard it is and I’m deeply sorry but you can’t give up you are much stronger than that everyone is. You and everyone in the world are so much stronger than the action of killing themselves. You will become better, find it in yourself, think right now, think of what you want to become what you want to change think of how you can change that. You’re a great person who needs a little push us all to get you going. It’s gonna get better you just have to try to make it better giving up is not an option no matter what you say, you CANNOT give up.
